Prevention: Practice crop rotation i.e. plant cassava after maize
Plant clean and disease-free maize seeds
Monitoring: Observe for the presence of galls swelling on: tassels, husks, ears/kernels, stalks, leaves, prop roots
Direct Control: Destruction of infected plants by burning or burying away from the maize farm
Cut out and destroy the gall before the smut ruptures
Restrictions: Use cost effective and readily available fungicides e.g.
Cupric oxide (CuO); 50 g to 5 litres of water per 0.5 acres
II (Moderately hazardous); Re-entry interval: 2 weeks; Pre-harvest interval: 10 weeks; Always ensure your protective gears / apparels are put on, e.g. goggles, overalls , respirators etc.
